personality: 7 Dark-First Utility with 6 Glass / Luxe DARK accents
personality_one_liner: A premium, broadcast-style dark UI built for high-contrast visibility on the course, elevated by cinematic golf aesthetics and gold accents.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing for tap targets (min 56pt) on course. Use md/lg for tight component groupings and xl/2xl to separate matches.

do's: Use on sticky headers above scrolling scorecards
Use subtle blur over the hero banner
dont's: Do not use on match cards or buttons (need solid contrast outdoors)

screens.name: Teams
screens.purpose: Display overall leaderboard and the two rosters (NZ vs World).
screens.layout: Hero banner at top (trophy). Overall scoreboard fixed below hero. Then a Segmented Control to flip between Team NZ and Team World rosters. Vertical list of player cards (photo, name, bio).

screens.name: R1 (Alternate Shot)
screens.purpose: Show Round 1 2v2 matches and allow scoring.

states.empty: No pairings set for Round 1 yet.

screens.layout: List of match cards. Each card has 2 NZ players vs 2 World players, a live status pill ('🇳🇿 2 UP thru 14'), and a row of 3 massive buttons for one-hand entry: 🇳🇿 WIN, HALVED, WORLD WIN.

screens.name: R2 (Best Ball)
screens.layout: Identical layout to R1, reflecting Best Ball 2v2 format.

screens.name: R3 (Heads Up)
screens.layout: List of match cards. 1 NZ player vs 1 World player. Same live status pill and 3 large result buttons.

screens.name: Admin PIN
screens.layout: Simple dark modal with a numeric PIN pad (huge touch targets) and a submit button.

screens.name: Admin Bios
screens.layout: List of players. Tapping opens a bottom sheet to edit Name, Bio, and replace Photo.

screens.name: Admin Pairings
screens.layout: Select round dropdown. List of slots. Tap slot to select player from dropdown (with visual warning if player already used in that round). Huge sticky Save Changes button at bottom.

hero_banner.alt: Cinematic Swifty Cup trophy banner with NZ and World colors

instructions_to_main_agent: Design the layout as a dark, high-contrast 'Stadium Night' theme. The primary canvas is deep navy (#0e1a2b), using NZ blue (#4fb3ff) and World orange (#ff8c5a) as team identifiers.

The hero banner is provided by the user in a ZIP file (banner.png). Place it at the top of the Teams/Leaderboard view. Use the provided asset. If unavailable during prototyping, mock it with a dark gradient placeholder.
Use 'Barlow Condensed' for all numeric scores, match status (e.g. 2 UP), and round headers. Use 'Manrope' for player names and body text.

For the Match Cards on R1, R2, and R3: These must be massive, legible outdoors. Display the team colors heavily. Each Match Card should have a 'Live' pulsing dot (use a small reanimated circle with the success or info color).

The 3 result buttons (🇳🇿 WIN, HALVED, WORLD WIN) must have a min-height of 56pt and fill the width of the card. They need to be easily tapped with one thumb while holding the phone. Style the buttons with the team colors: NZ Win (Blue), World Win (Orange), Halved (Gold/Grey).
Use the NZ flag emoji 🇳🇿 explicitly as requested, do not substitute with the letters 'NZ'.
For the Admin area, use a simple 3-dot menu icon in the header to open the PIN modal.
In the Admin Pairings page, use a highly visible warning state (borderStrong in Danger Red) if a player is duplicated in the same round.
Make sure all bottom tabs and headers have a glassmorphism effect, except for android low-end devices which should fallback to solid surfaceSecondary.
Ensure the scoreboard remains sticky when scrolling through match lists so the overall context is always visible.
